final.summary: Outfall pH stayed near neutral and the tank level stayed flat through the S2 gap, with no rise that would indicate overflow. Power readings are consistent with the meter photo and show no replay. A lab sample at 13:40 on 13 Oct shows BOD 20.9 mg/L below the 30 mg/L limit. The ETP inflow meter S2 is missing from 14:00 on 13 Oct to 08:50 on 14 Oct, covering most of the treatment interval, so inflow cannot be verified for that stretch.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.
